info.description: Marketplace backend API for buyers, sellers and admins.
info.title: Go Marketplace API

post.description: Generates a reset token for the given email
Authenticates user and returns access + refresh tokens
Deletes all refresh tokens for the current user
Rotates refresh token from cookie and returns new access token
Creates a buyer account and returns access + refresh tokens
Resets password using the reset token from forgot-password flow

get.description: Returns all items in the current user's shopping cart

delete.description: Removes all items from the current user's cart

post.description: Adds a product to the current user's cart (or updates quantity if already present)

delete.description: Removes a specific item from the current user's cart

patch.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item

post.description: Creates an order from provided items, decrements stock

get.description: Returns order details (buyer or seller of items in order)
Returns orders containing products from seller's store (seller role)

post.description: Initiates a payment for an order (returns confirmation URL)
Receives payment status updates from provider (no JWT auth)
Refunds a succeeded payment (order owner only)

get.description: Returns paginated list of active products

post.description: Creates a product with status 'pending' (requires seller role)

get.description: Returns a tree of categories and subcategories

delete.description: Deletes an image from a product (seller only)

post.description: Uploads an image file and associates it with a product (seller only)
post.summary: Upload an image for a product

get.description: Returns a presigned URL for direct upload to S3 (seller only)

patch.description: Approve, reject or archive a product (admin only)

get.description: Returns paginated list of active products for a specific store

post.description: Creates a store and upgrades user role to seller

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
